ja298:1.2: the banyan and the wave-leafed fig,
ja298:1.3: Come on, let’s go, you should eat, why die from hunger?
ja298:2.1: So he is satisfied who respects the elder,
ja298:2.3: As I’m satisfied today, eating the tree’s fruit.
ja298:3.1: When woodman would deceive woodman, and monkey (would deceive) monkey,
ja298:3.3: A young monkey might have faith,
ja298:3.4: but not an old one in ageing monkey.
